science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Stabilize the main induction spire before the sheer tears it apart.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Secure enough power reserves for the oncoming dark phase.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Complete The Stormbreaker project to harvest permanent atmospheric energy.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The churning expanse of the ferrofluid sea heaved under the twin suns, tearing itself into magnetic froth where the Kelvin-Helmholtz shear ripped across the surface. Hector stood on the metallic shale beach, the ozone-rich spray coating his insulated boots in a dark, iridescent sheen. The sky was an bruised purple, electric arcs dancing between low-hanging clouds.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Iridescent black waves crashing against rusty red metallic shale, illuminated by violent purple arcs from the sky.
sensory_palette.sound: A deafening, rhythmic booming like a bass drum played by thunder, underlaid with the high-pitched whine of shearing magnetic fields.
sensory_palette.smell: Sharp, metallic ozone cutting through the damp, heavy scent of static-charged mist.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A freezing, biting chill against the skin, punctuated by sudden waves of blistering heat from the electrical arcs.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: The metallic tang of a dying battery on the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A massive copper pillar driven into the bedrock, currently absorbing dangerous levels of charge.
A shifting mound of highly magnetic sand that can be used to redirect the ferrofluid waves.
A sparking, partially exposed coil from an old Enclave generator, acting as a lightning rod.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To rip apart anything not perfectly aligned with the magnetic field lines.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generating sudden, unpredictable spikes in magnetic pressure and lateral force.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The shear is destabilizing the grounding spire Hector is trying to secure.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: If left unchecked, the shear will rip the spire from its moorings and unleash a catastrophic arc flash.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The grounding spire is failing under the extreme magnetic shear.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The Stormbreaker needs this spire to safely vent excess charge from the grid.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Mastering this environment is the only way to build a sustainable power source for the Enclave.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If Hector fails, the spire snaps, releasing a localized EMP that will fry the scouting gear Kaio is carrying.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Hector misjudges the magnetic polarity, increasing the strain on the spire.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Hector secures the spire, but takes a bad shock in the process, dropping his primary wrench into the sea.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Hector perfectly aligns the shunt, stabilizing the spire and venting the charge safely.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Hector not only secures the spire but identifies a harmonic resonance pattern in the shear, providing crucial data for Jane.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector grips the shuddering copper, shouting over the roar as he prepares to lock the shunt. He looks back towards the dunes, signaling Kaio to move in.
